verdict.rationale: Bolna's call history shows performance metrics, recordings, transcripts and raw execution data for debugging after calls. Per-call webhooks could feed an external alerting system, but nothing documents real-time call monitoring or built-in alerts. Missing for 10: live/in-progress call monitoring, built-in alerting on agent misbehavior, error-rate spike detection or thresholds, aggregate production health dashboards, independent corroboration.
